answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to lock a refundable stake that is slashed when the agent misbehaves. One honest participant pays the bond once, like dropping a single marble into a jar, but an attacker spawning thousands of fake agents must fund every copy, so the cost ripples outward with each clone. Honest behavior returns the stake untouched, while fraud forfeits it: no stake, no seat at the table, and no ivory-tower exemption for anyone.
